finalText:
Found it: `processOrder.js` acquired a connection directly and released it only on success — a failed order (bad payload) never gave the connection back. The logs match exactly: pool usage climbed 2/5 → 5/5 during a run of `invalid order payload` failures, then `pool exhausted`, then the api and worker both went unresponsive and got restarted around 2am.

Fix was a `try/finally` around the release in `src/jobs/processOrder.js`, same pattern the request handler already used safely. All 4 tests pass now (was failing before on the leak test).
